title: Promote shipped-but-proposed ADRs to accepted (or supersede if stale)

context.problem: 12 of 21 ADRs sit in 'proposed' status. hex adr list on 2026-04-21 showed ADRs 008, 010-012, 014-018 as proposed despite most decisions being live in code (React app, provider registry, spec caching, version-centric IA). 'proposed' is drift, not deliberation. Audit each, promote the shipped ones, supersede the stale ones.

steps.name: Audit each proposed ADR against current code
steps.description: For each of ADR-008, ADR-010, ADR-011, ADR-012, ADR-014, ADR-015, ADR-016, ADR-017, ADR-018: read the ADR body, then grep the codebase for the decision's load-bearing artifact (e.g. ADR-012 → src/App.jsx + vite.config; ADR-010 → provider-registry.js; ADR-017 → version-centric routes; ADR-018 → SchemaCache port + adapter). Classify each as: (a) shipped-and-current → promote to accepted, (b) shipped-but-diverged → accept-with-amendment, (c) abandoned → supersede with a brief ADR explaining why.
steps.done_condition: docs/workplans/adr-audit-2026-04-21.md exists with one row per proposed ADR: status verdict + evidence file:line + recommended action.

steps.name: Promote shipped ADRs to accepted via hex adr update
steps.description: For every ADR classified 'shipped-and-current' in step-1, run `hex adr update <ID> --status accepted` (or equivalent tool). For 'shipped-but-diverged' ADRs, append a dated 'Amendments' section documenting the divergence before accepting.
steps.done_condition: hex adr list shows no proposed ADRs for shipped decisions. Each newly-accepted ADR has a commit trail.

steps.name: Supersede abandoned ADRs
steps.description: For every ADR classified 'abandoned' in step-1, write a successor ADR via `hex adr create` that explains what replaced it (or that the feature was dropped), then mark the old one superseded.
steps.done_condition: Every previously-proposed ADR is either accepted or superseded. hex adr list shows proposed count === 0 (excluding any intentionally-open proposals).

steps.name: Commit and verify
steps.description: Single commit: 'chore(adr): promote shipped proposals to accepted + supersede stale'. Run hex analyze . to confirm no architectural regressions.
steps.done_condition: Commit pushed. hex analyze clean. hex adr list proposed-count matches audit expectations.
